gloss: to consist of; to hold true; to be valid

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {成|な}り{立|た}ちませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {成|な}り{立|た}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {成|な}り{立|た}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to consist of; to be composed of
definitions.explanation: to be formed or made up of certain elements

definitions.gloss: to hold true; to be valid; to work
definitions.explanation: for an argument, agreement, or system to function properly

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}は{人|ひと}と{人|ひと}の{関係|かんけい}で{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Society consists of relationships between people.

examples.japanese: この{理論|りろん}は{成|な}り{立|た}たない。
{商売|しょうばい}が{成|な}り{立|た}つか{心配|しんぱい}だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about whether the business will work.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}は{双方|そうほう}の{合意|ごうい}で{成|な}り{立|た}つ。
examples.english: A contract is valid when both parties agree.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}は{漢字|かんじ}、ひらがな、カタカナで{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Japanese consists of kanji, hiragana, and katakana.

examples.japanese: その{言|い}い{訳|わけ}は{成|な}り{立|た}たない。
この{組織|そしき}は{多|おお}くのボランティアで{成|な}り{立|た}っている。
examples.english: This organization is made up of many volunteers.

notes:
{成|な}り{立|た}つ describes something being composed of elements or being valid/functional.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (つ-verb)
- Intransitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- {成|な}る (to become) + {立|た}つ (to stand)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Composition (what something consists of)
- Sense 2: Validity/functionality (whether something works)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～で{成|な}り{立|た}つ (to consist of ~)
- ～が{成|な}り{立|た}つ (~ is valid)
- {成|な}り{立|た}たない (doesn't hold, doesn't work)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理論|りろん}が{成|な}り{立|た}つ (theory holds)
- {契約|けいやく}が{成|な}り{立|た}つ (contract is valid)
- {商売|しょうばい}が{成|な}り{立|た}つ (business is viable)
- {議論|ぎろん}が{成|な}り{立|た}たない (argument doesn't hold)

NEGATIVE FORM:
- {成|な}り{立|た}たない is very common
- Used to dismiss invalid arguments or unworkable situations

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {成|な}り{上|あ}がる (to rise in status)
- {成|な}り{下|さ}がる (to sink, become degraded)

RELATED WORDS:
- {構成|こうせい}される (to be composed of - formal)
- {通用|つうよう}する (to be valid - more general)
- {機能|きのう}する (to function)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in both spoken and written Japanese.
